description: 150 texts of messy but ordinary writing aimed at what the first four messy sweeps did not cover: paragraphs of several sentences with quotations and parentheses nested, lists with numbers and units, street addresses, e-mail and web addresses inside sentences, times and dates in several written forms, money with cents and money ranges, dictionary abbreviations inside a sentence and at its end, words in capitals and in mixed case, contractions and possessives together, foreign names, stray punctuation, and paragraphs that mix these. For Paul at 180 words per minute, grouped by kind, ten texts a group. Written before any export and not edited afterwards; no text is taken from an earlier list. Measurement only.
